1.w: Praise the Lord . Praise, you servants of the Lord , praise the name of the Lord .

2.w: May the Lord ’s name be praised now and forevermore.

3.w: From east to west the Lord ’s name is deserving of praise.

4.w: The Lord is exalted over all the nations; his splendor reaches beyond the sky.

5.w: Who can compare to the Lord our God, who sits on a high throne?

6.w: He bends down to look at the sky and the earth.

7.w: He raises the poor from the dirt and lifts up the needy from the garbage pile

8.w: that he might seat him with princes, with the princes of his people.

9.w: He makes the barren woman of the family a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord .
